_comment: B2 R7 loot adoption status, separate from the data. A table's adoption follows its owner monster's selection: PENDING_REVIEW, DEFERRED, EXCLUDED, or NOT_APPLICABLE for a non-enemy. Nothing is adopted: no table drops in the game, every item decision stays pending, and the game's own (legacy) loot is unchanged (its file hashes are below).

items.note: Every item decision stays pending (PENDING_SELECTION); this registry selects nothing.

legacy_loot.note: The game's drop data is not read or changed by the reference registries.

hoard_boss_loot.reason: adopted with the treasure-map hoards system

rift_clear_pools.reason: adopted with the the Rift system

rift_first_clear.reason: adopted with the the Rift system

treasure_vault_payouts.reason: adopted with the treasure-map hoards system

weekly_boss_tables.reason: adopted with the weekly rewards system

world_quest_class_loot.reason: adopted with the world quests system

status_values.DEFERRED: waits for its system (the Rift, seasonal events, buddies, delves, weekly rewards, world quests, treasure maps)
status_values.EXCLUDED: outside the game by owner decision (Scorching Wastes, Studio overlay)
status_values.NOT_APPLICABLE: the owner is not an enemy (pet, practice target, objective, ambient)
status_values.PENDING_REVIEW: the owner monster may be adopted; its table is a candidate, not active
